question: A train 1386 m long is running at 18 km/hr. How long will it take to clear a 564 m long platform completely?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Distance = Train Length + Platform Length = 1386 + 564 = 1950 m

Speed = 18 km/hr = 18 × 5/18 = 5 m/s

Time = 1950 ÷ 5 = 390 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 390 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given:

Length of Train (L₁) = 1386 m

Length of Platform (L₂) = 564 m

Speed of Train (S) = 18 km/hr

 Train (1386 m) Platform (564 m) 
• 
• 
• Total Distance = 1386 + 564 = 1950 m Speed = 18 km/hr → 5 m/s 

Formula Used:

Time = Total Distance ÷ Speed

Calculations:

⇒ Total distance to be covered = L₁ + L₂

⇒ Total Distance = 1386 + 564 = 1950 m

⇒ Speed in m/s = 18 × (5/18) = 5 m/s

⇒ Time taken = 1950 ÷ 5

⇒ Time taken = 390 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 390 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unit Conversion

To convert speed from km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.

Relative Speed (Same Direction)

When two objects move in the same direction with speeds u and v, relative speed = |u − v|.

Relative Speed (Opposite Direction)

When two objects move in opposite directions with speeds u and v, relative speed = u + v.

Crossing a Pole/Point Object

When a train crosses a pole or a stationary man, the distance covered is equal to the length of the train itself.
